subject: Logic
title: First Mover Advantage
description: A quick win: understand First Mover Advantage.

hook.text: The first company to dominate a market often keeps that lead for decades. But being first isn't always best.

buildup.text: First-mover advantage means acting early to grab resources, customers, or positions before competitors can.

discovery.text: Amazon, Google, and eBay all benefited massively from being early movers in their spaces.

twist.text: But MySpace, Friendster, and Netscape moved first too—and were crushed by patient second movers.

climax.text: First-mover wins when switching costs are high. Second-mover wins when learning from others' mistakes is cheap.

punchline.text: First or fast—know which game you're in.

quiz.question: When does first-mover advantage tend to succeed?
options: When switching costs are high for customers
When the product is easily copied
